### Pure Things for the Pure
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/pure-things-for-the-pure
Passage: Titus 1:15
Points:
- The false teachers in Crete promoted legalism through manmade regulations and external notions of ritual purity.
- Christ fulfilled and set aside ceremonial purity distinctions, sanctifying all created things for believers who receive them with thanksgiving.
- Christian freedom permits diverse personal choices regarding indifferent matters, meaning believers must never bind the consciences of others.
- A corrupted mind and conscience fail to understand God's kingdom, fixating instead on external taboos.
- Believers must remain alert to their own internal inclination toward legalism and remember the liberty bought by Christ.
